motivation_from_completed_h4a.interpretation_before_h5: The threshold sensitivity suggests a scale-dependence question but is not itself evidence for a scale mechanism. H5 tests that question directly.

primary_frame.rationale: Use the more reliable >=10-photo frame while allowing the >=3-cell species that motivated the scale question. This frame was selected after H4a and is therefore exploratory.

colour_climate_statistic.species_level_response: Spearman correlation between within-species pairwise colour JSD and pairwise RMS standardized macroclimate distance
colour_climate_statistic.colour_representation: soft four-group composition collapsed prospectively from the retained nine flower palette fractions

primary_scale_moderator.name: mean_pairwise_h1_cell_centroid_great_circle_km
primary_scale_moderator.species_level_global_statistic: Spearman correlation across species between species climate-colour rho and log1p(mean pairwise H1-cell centroid great-circle distance)
primary_scale_moderator.ecological_reading_if_supported: within-species climate-colour coupling is stronger among spatially localized species and weakens across broader geographic spans

null.operation: independently permute colour cell labels within each species, recompute each species climate-colour rho, then recompute the across-species scale-moderation statistic

decision_rule.support: primary evaluable species >=30, observed primary scale-moderation rho < 0, and one-sided permutation p_lower < 0.05
decision_rule.h4b_directional_colour_or_climate_driver: remains closed regardless of H5 because H4a primary was not supported

claim_ceiling: H5 is a post-H4a exploratory moderation test. Even if supported, it would identify scale-dependent statistical coupling only; it would not establish adaptation, selection, causal climate effects, pigment mechanism, or rescue the non-significant preregistered H1/H2/H4a primary tests.
